 City-wise petrol, diesel and CNG rates on October 27 
 Petrol and diesel rates remained largely unchanged again today while CNG rates are also holding steady.
 Brent crude traded at $114.99 per barrel in early Asian trade. WTI, on the other hand hovered around $101.
 Story continues below Advertisement 
 Remove Ad 
 Oil flows have almost recovered to pre-war levels, however, shipping costs continue to remain elevated. Additionally, according to a Reuters report, Hezbollah after receiving funds from Iran was preparing for a new regional war in Lebanon.
 Meanwhile, US forces are blocking all Iranian ports to cut off the country’s exports while helping other West Asian Gulf producers move through the Strait of Hormuz, according to Bloomberg.
